_readme: ISOT's own strike list. Edit on GitHub and commit: the app reads it on every open. The official register (via /api/strikes) is merged in automatically; add an entry here only to correct its wording or to add something it misses. kind: local | general | rail | air. scope: turin | region | national. date and end: YYYY-MM-DD. Past entries disappear on their own.

strikes.title: General strike, public and private sectors
strikes.note: All day. Buses, trams, metro and trains may stop outside guaranteed hours.

strikes.title: EasyJet cabin crew
strikes.note: 24 hours. Check your flight with EasyJet before going to the airport.

strikes.title: ENAV air traffic staff (4 h) and EasyJet cabin crew (24 h)
strikes.note: Flights across Italy may be delayed or cancelled. Check with your airline.
